verdict.rationale: Remote desktop sharing and access is a fair capability to ask of a desktop operating system, but the evidence pack never documents a remote desktop or desktop-sharing feature in Fedora Workstation. The only related item is a community comment about Teams screen sharing working under Wayland. That is in-app screen sharing within a third-party video-call app, not remote desktop access, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can share my desktop remotely or access a remote desktop session from my machine
